locked_door.name: Stuck Door
locked_door.text: The door is jammed! Pick the SAME move as your buddy to shove it open together.
locked_door.win_text: Both of you hit the door at once. CRASH, it flies open!
locked_door.fail_text: One pushed, one pulled. The door laughed at you.

chatty_chachi.name: Chatty Chachi Ghost
chatty_chachi.text: A ghost auntie wants to chat about your whole family tree. Be patient (Hold) or let your buddy rescue you (Help).
chatty_chachi.win_text: You nodded politely and escaped the 40-minute story.
chatty_chachi.fail_text: She started on your cousin's wedding. Panic rises.

slipper_bat.name: Slipper Bat
slipper_bat.text: A flying slipper with wings is coming right at you! Run (Sprint) or cover your buddy (Help).
slipper_bat.win_text: Dodged! The slipper smacked a painting instead.

biryani_blob.name: Biryani Blob
biryani_blob.text: A giant blob smells SO good. Resist it (Hold) or run past it (Sprint).
biryani_blob.win_text: You ignored the smell. Legends only.
biryani_blob.fail_text: You took one sniff and lost a whole turn drooling.

mirror_twin.name: Mirror Twin
mirror_twin.text: A mirror twin copies your move! Choose DIFFERENT moves from your buddy to confuse it.
mirror_twin.win_text: The twin got confused and walked into itself.
mirror_twin.fail_text: You did the same thing, so the twin copied you perfectly. Annoying.

dancing_uncles.name: Dancing Uncles
dancing_uncles.text: Uncles are doing the wedding dance on the only path. Sneak around (Tiptoe) or help each other through (Help).
dancing_uncles.win_text: You slipped between two dancing uncles like a ninja.
dancing_uncles.fail_text: An uncle pulled you into the dance. Five minutes gone.

buffet_line.name: Endless Buffet Line
buffet_line.text: The buffet line blocks the hall. Barge through (Sprint) or have your buddy clear a path (Help).
buffet_line.win_text: You squeezed past the naan table. Respect.
buffet_line.fail_text: You got stuck behind someone taking 14 pieces of chicken.

ferris_wheel.name: Stuck Ferris Wheel
ferris_wheel.text: The ferris wheel must be started together! Pick the SAME move as your buddy.
ferris_wheel.win_text: In sync! The wheel spins and drops you at the top.
ferris_wheel.fail_text: Out of sync, so the wheel jerked and swung you around.
